Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 46
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Agenda
Thursday, Ashoj 1, 2083
1:00 PM
1. Presentation of Committee Report on Bill
Honorable Chairperson Hari Dhakal of the State Affairs and Good Governance Committee will present the "Report of the Committee on the National Service Corps Bill, 2083".
2. Work related to Agreement
Honorable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam will present a proposal to "Discuss the Agreement on the Conservation and Sustainable Use of Marine Biodiversity in Areas Beyond National Jurisdiction under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea".
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
